an3.63:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena venāgapuraṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
an3.63:1.3: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito venāgapuraṃ anuppatto.
an3.63:1.4: “taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato :
an3.63:1.5: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
an3.63:1.6: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
an3.63:1.7: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an3.63:1.8: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
an3.63:2.1: atha kho venāgapurikā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho venāgapuriko vacchagotto brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.63:3.1: acchariyaṃ bho gotama, abbhutaṃ bho gotama,
an3.63:3.2: yāvañcidaṃ bhoto gotamassa vippasannāni indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
an3.63:3.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama sāradaṃ badarapaṇḍu parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ.
an3.63:3.4: evameva bhoto gotamassa vippasannāni indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
an3.63:3.5: seyyathāpi bho gotama tālapakkaṃ sampati bandhanā pavuttaṃ parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ.
an3.63:3.6: evameva bhoto gotamassa vippasannāni indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.”
an3.63:3.7: “seyyathāpi bho gotama, nekkhaṃ jambonadaṃ dakkhakammāraputtasuparikammakataṃ ukkāmukhe sukusalasampahaṭṭhaṃ paṇḍukambale nikkhittaṃ bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
an3.63:3.8: evameva bhoto gotamassa vippasannāni indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
an3.63:3.9: yāni nūna tāni bho gotama uccāsayanamahāsayanāni. seyyathidaṃ :
an3.63:3.10: āsandi pallaṅko gonako cittakā paṭikā paṭalikā tūlikā vikatikā uddalomī ekantalomī kaṭṭhissaṃ koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ rathattharaṃ ajinappaveṇiṃ kādalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhato lohitakūpadhānaṃ, evarūpānaṃ nūna bhavaṃ gotamo uccāsayanamahāsayanānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī“ti.
an3.63:4.1: [bhagavā:] yāni kho pana tāni brāhmaṇa, uccāsayanamahāsayanāni. seyyathidaṃ :
an3.63:4.2: āsandi pallaṅko gonako cittakā paṭikā paṭalikā tūlikā vikatikā uddalomi ekantalomi kaṭṭhissaṃ koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ rathattharaṃ ajinappaveṇiṃ kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhato lohitakūpadhānaṃ.
an3.63:4.3: dullabhāni tāni pabbajitānaṃ, laddhā ca na kappanti.
an3.63:5.1: tīṇi kho imāni brāhmaṇa, uccāsayanamahāsayanāni, yesāhaṃ etarahi nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an3.63:5.3: dibbaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ, brahmaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ, ariyaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ.
an3.63:5.4: imāni kho brāhmaṇa, tīṇi uccāsayanamahāsayanāni, yesāhaṃ etarahi nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti.
an3.63:6.1: [brāhmaṇo:] katamaṃ pana bho gotama, dibbaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ, yassa bhavaṃ gotamo etarahi nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī?ti.
an3.63:6.2: [bhagavā:] idāhaṃ brāhmaṇa yaṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharāmi, so pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya tameva gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisāmi.
an3.63:6.4: so yadeva tattha honti tiṇāni vā paṇṇāni vā tāni ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā nisīdāmi, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an3.63:6.5: so vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an3.63:6.6: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an3.63:6.7: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharāmi sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an3.63:6.8: sukhassa ca pahāṇā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an3.63:6.9: so ce ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, evambhūto caṅkamāmi, dibbo me eso tasmiṃ samaye caṅkamo hoti.
an3.63:6.10: so ce ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, evaṃ bhūto tiṭṭhāmi, dibbaṃ me etaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ṭhānaṃ hoti.
an3.63:6.11: so ce ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, evambhūto nisīdāmi, dibbaṃ me etaṃ tasmiṃ samaye āsanaṃ hoti.
an3.63:6.12: so ce ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, evambhūto seyyaṃ kappemi, dibbaṃ me etaṃ tasmiṃ samaye uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ hoti.
an3.63:6.13: idaṃ kho taṃ brāhmaṇa, dibbaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ, yassāhaṃ etarahi nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti.
an3.63:7.1: [brāhmaṇo:] acchariyaṃ bho gotama, abbhutaṃ bho gotama,
an3.63:7.2: ko cañño evarūpassa dibbassa uccāsayanamahāsayanassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, aññatra bhotā gotamena.
an3.63:8.1: katamaṃ pana taṃ bho gotama, brahmaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ, yassa bhavaṃ gotamo etarahi nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti?
an3.63:8.2: [bhagavā:] idāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, yaṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharāmi, so pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya tameva gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisāmi.
an3.63:8.4: so yadeva tattha honti tiṇāni vā, paṇṇāni vā tāni ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā nisīdāmi, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an3.63:8.5: so mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharāmi, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharāmi.
an3.63:8.8: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharāmi, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharāmi.
an3.63:8.9: so ce ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, evaṃ bhūto caṅkamāmi, brahmā me eso tasmiṃ samaye caṅkamo hoti.
an3.63:8.10: so ce ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, evambhūto tiṭṭhāmi -
an3.63:8.12: seyyaṃ kappemi, brahmaṃ me etaṃ tasmiṃ samaye uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ hoti.
an3.63:8.13: idaṃ kho taṃ brāhmaṇa, brahmaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ, yassāhaṃ etarahi nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti.
an3.63:9.1: [brāhmaṇo:] acchariyaṃ bho gotama, abbhutaṃ bho gotama,
an3.63:9.2: ko cañño evarūpassa brahmassa uccāsayanamahāsayanassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, aññatra bhotā gotamena.
an3.63:10.1: katamaṃ pana taṃ bho gotama, ariyaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ, yassa bhavaṃ gotamo etarahi nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti ?
an3.63:10.2: [bhagavā:] idhāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, yaṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharāmi, so pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya tameva gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisāmi.
an3.63:10.4: so yadeva tattha honti tiṇāni vā paṇṇāni vā, tāni ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā nisīdāmi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an3.63:10.6: rāgo me pahīno; ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
an3.63:10.8: moho me pahīṇo ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
an3.63:10.9: so ce ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, evambhūto caṅkamāmi, ariyo me eso tasmiṃ samaye caṅkamo hoti.
an3.63:10.10: so ce ahaṃ brāhmaṇa evambhūto tiṭṭhāmi …pe…
an3.63:10.12: seyyaṃ kappemi. ariyaṃ me etaṃ tasmiṃ samaye uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ hoti.
an3.63:10.13: idaṃ kho taṃ brāhmaṇa ariyaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ. yassāhaṃ etarahi nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti.
an3.63:11.1: [brāhmaṇo:] acchariyaṃ bho gotama, abbhutaṃ, bho gotama,
an3.63:11.2: ko cañño evarūpassa ariyassa uccāsayanamahāsayanassa nikāmalāmī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhī aññatra bhotā gotamena.
an3.63:12.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama,
an3.63:12.2: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an3.63:12.3: ete mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma, dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
an3.63:12.4: upāsake no bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃgateti.
